dataset.description: During the project, I will develop such research instruments for ethnographic linguo-didactics research as: classroom observation form; list of teacher interview questions; list of student express interview questions; student survey; categories and parameters for the analysis of texts included in the language learning; categories and criteria for the analysis of schoolscape texts.

distribution.title: The main purpose of the data collection in eight fieldworks in Latvia and Latvian diaspora is to test the developed linguo-didactics method with a set of research instruments.

dataset.title: LCS FARP

dmp.description:
The project focuses on text in language class and all that is done with it to help students develop the literacy necessary to work purposefully with texts, think critically, and make responsible decisions. 

The aim of the project is to develop a novel interdisciplinary method with a set of research instruments that allows for a multifaceted and in-depth study of texts and literacy-developing strategies in language-teaching.

project.description: Development of a Comprehensive Methodology for the In-Depth Study of Students’ Textual Experiences and Literacy Capabilities in the Language Classroom
